desc:
Advanced Armament Company’s Ti-Rant 45M is a versatile silencer that adapts from a 9-inch suppressor to a 6.9-inch suppressor with just a twist. You can immediately reconfigure this AAC silencer from full length to compact, and no tools are needed with this innovative design. The modularity of the Ti-Rant 45M is an improvement over the legendary AAC Ti-Rant 45, which has been a top-performing .45 ACP pistol silencer. Made with Grade 9 titanium, 17-4 PH stainless steel, and 7075-T6 aluminum, the Ti-Rant 45M is an Advanced Armament Suppressor that is treated with black PVD that balances lightweight with durability. The AAC Ti-Rant 45M weights only 12.3 ounces in Full and 10.6 ounces in Compact, and is rated for 300 Blackout subsonic ammunition as well as .45 ACP, .44 Magnum, 9mm, and many other pistol calibers. With a baffle stack that’s easily removed for cleaning and maintenance, the AAC Tirant 45 suppressor is the AAC silencer that you’ll confidently use on your rimfire hosts such as .22 LR. The Ti-Rant 45M was designed with .45 ACP pistols in mind and has an impressive 31 dB sound reduction performance.
One of the reasons the Advanced Armament Company Ti-Rant 45M is a fantastic choice for your firearms collection is its versatility. The Ti-Rant 45M is ready to suppress a wide range of pistol cartridges: .45 caliber and smaller in diameter. And you’ll be able to easily switch between full and compact sizes, so you’ll never be in a situation where it’s too large for your gun or too small for your caliber.
